quote.text:
For the second time in his career,
职业生涯第二次，

Alejandro Davidovich Fokina
达维多维奇·福基纳

is into the final of a Masters 1000.
打进了大师赛决赛。

quote_cues_absolute.en: For the second time in his career,
is into the final of a Masters 1000.

quote.text:
Another set point.
又一个盘点。

Dominant on serve once again.
他的发球再次展现统治力。

quote_cues_absolute.zh: 他的发球再次展现统治力。

quote.text:
Oh, it doesn't get any better than that.
噢，这一分真是精彩到了极点！

quote_cues_absolute.en: Oh, it doesn't get any better than that.
quote_cues_absolute.zh: 噢，这一分真是精彩到了极点！

quote.text:
For the second time in his career,
职业生涯第二次，

Alejandro Davidovich Fokina
达维多维奇·福基纳

is into the final of a Masters 1000.
打进了大师赛决赛。

And for the second time in his career,
同时，这也是他职业生涯第二次，

he gets the better of Alexander Zverev.
击败亚历山大·兹维列夫。

What an Asian swing he's enjoying.
他的亚洲赛季，表现多么出色！

Champion in Chengdu three weeks ago.
三周前，他在成都夺冠。

His unbeaten run on Chinese soil gathers more pace.
他在中国的不败征程，继续向前。
